name: Typhoon Day
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · 颱風假! The best kind of day off — the coast road's shut, nobody's going anywhere, and all of South is stuck grinning at the rain. Everyone standing in South keeps 1 FEWER ingredient from this Market Run (you lose nothing you already hold — you just stayed in).
art_note: A cosy lit window looking out on a grey coastal storm

name: Sold Out
effect: ⦿ YOU · 完售. The last portion left with the person directly in front of you — and they are NOT sorry. Keep 1 FEWER ingredient from this draw.
art_note: A hand-lettered 完售 SOLD OUT sign across a stall

name: Scooter Gridlock
effect: ➤ NEXT DOOR · The jam backs into the next town. An agent in a NEIGHBOURING region takes their next Travel with NO ingredient (tempo tax, not a lost turn).
art_note: A wall of scooters packed bumper-to-bumper at a red light

name: Plum Rains
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · 梅雨 — six weeks of grey drizzle and everything's gone damp. Every agent standing in Central lets 1 held 茶 Tea or 糖 Sugar go off (to the region discard) — the leaves and the sugar drank the rain. No Tea or Sugar in hand? The damp finds nothing.
art_note: Grey drizzle beading on jars of tea and sugar in a quiet inland shop

name: The Long Queue
effect: ⦿ YOU · Forty deep and growing — and a queue this long is its own billboard. Keep 1 FEWER ingredient from this draw (you waited), AND grow 1 follower (supply → your board) — everyone wants to know what's worth the wait.
art_note: A queue snaking forty-deep around a pop-up stall while onlookers film it

name: Mango Season
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The whole coast smells like a smoothie — and every agent on the island just turned their head. Everyone standing in South takes 1 free 糖 Sugar.
art_note: Crates of golden mangoes piled at a roadside stand

name: The Aunty Insists
effect: ⦿ YOU · You said you were full three plates ago; she's already reaching for the ladle. Take 1 free North signature (豬肉 Pork).
art_note: A smiling auntie pressing an extra ladle into your bowl

name: 24-Hour Convenience
effect: ⦿ YOU · Out east the local specialties are a hike away — but the 便利商店 never shuts and stocks a little of everything. Take 1 free ingredient of ANY type into your Larder (grab whatever's on the shelf).
art_note: A glowing 24-hour convenience store on an empty street

name: A Featured Spot
effect: ⦿ YOU · Someone tagged your agency in a post that took off. Grow 1 follower (take 1 from your supply to your board) — your name carries a little further.
art_note: Phones held up filming a bright breakfast stall

name: Rough Seas
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The boats stayed in tonight — 風浪太大, no fresh catch coming ashore. Put the top card of this region's market to the BOTTOM of its deck (the good stuff just isn't landing).
art_note: A harbour of fishing boats tied up against a heaving dark sea

name: They Packed Up Early
effect: ⦿ YOU · You schlepped all the way over and they're already hosing down the grill — 收攤了, gone home. Your NEXT market draw here whiffs (no ingredient that draw; you still Travel and Promote, and you lose nothing you already hold).
art_note: A vendor hosing down a dark grill, shutters already halfway down

name: Second Wind
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · Out east everything runs late — a stall throws its shutters back up for the night crowd. Refill 1 EMPTY vendor slot in this region now (a rare early relief against the slow turnover; nothing happens if no slot is empty).
art_note: A shuttered stall rolling its shutter back up, lights flicking on for a late crowd

name: Night-Market Crush
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · Shoulder-to-shoulder, elbow-to-elbow — the crowd got to the front before you did. Everyone standing in North keeps 1 FEWER ingredient from this Market Run.
art_note: A packed night-market lane

name: Scooter Gridlock
effect: ➤ NEXT DOOR · The after-dinner jam spills over. An agent in a NEIGHBOURING region takes their next Travel with NO ingredient (tempo tax, not a lost turn).
art_note: Tail-lights of a scooter jam smeared across a wet road

name: Sudden Squall
effect: ➤ NEXT DOOR · A 西北雨 — the sky opens for ten furious minutes and the downpour drifts one town over. An agent in a NEIGHBOURING region keeps 1 FEWER ingredient from their next Market Run.
art_note: A sudden sheet of warm rain over glowing stalls

name: Last-Bus Rush
effect: ⦿ YOU · The last bus is boarding and so is half the night market — you grab and run. Keep 1 FEWER ingredient from this draw (no time to be choosy).
art_note: A crowd surging onto a departing lit bus

name: Market Anniversary
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The whole street's celebrating. Everyone standing in Central places up to 2 followers from their board onto a co-located face-up vendor (a stall you stand with).
art_note: A night market strung with anniversary banners and lanterns

name: Gone Viral
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · A reel just cleared a million views. Drop a Trending marker on the face-up night vendor here (the cheapest, if more than one) — whoever WINS that stall grows 1 follower (supply → board), because going viral swells the crowd. (Trending is the DYNAMIC hype marker — distinct from the printed ★ apex.)
art_note: A stall mobbed by phones

name: She Won't Take No
effect: ⦿ YOU · 'You're too thin!' She won't take no. Take 1 free South signature (海鮮 Seafood).
art_note: A beaming auntie loading fresh oysters onto your plate

name: The Blogger Arrives
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The whole town is mildly performing for the camera. Every agent's NEXT Promote places +1 follower (up to 3 from your board instead of 2).
art_note: A food blogger filming a steaming bowl ringed by onlookers

name: One More for the Road

art_note: A glowing convenience store humming on a quiet night street

name: In the News
effect: ⦿ YOU · A local news crew filmed your tour. Grow 1 follower (take 1 from your supply to your board).

name: Blogger's Pick
effect: ⦿ YOU · A travel blogger name-checked your agency. Grow 1 follower (take 1 from your supply to your board).
art_note: A laptop screen showing a glowing five-star write-up

name: A Bad Review
effect: ⦿ YOU · A one-star review makes the rounds — the crowd ebbs and its allegiance drifts to a rival's stall. Return 1 of your followers to your OWN supply (your crowd disperses — it does NOT join the rival).
art_note: A phone showing a lone one-star rating over a dim stall

name: A Mix-Up
effect: ⦿ YOU · You cut a corner and it showed — some of the crowd drifts elsewhere. Return 1 of your followers to your OWN supply (they drift off — not to any rival).
art_note: A flustered agent facing a muddled double-booking

name: Scheduled Maintenance
effect: ISLAND-WIDE (not a scoped event — its own banner). The HSR is down for EVERYONE. Until the start of YOUR next turn, North and South are NOT linked — everyone Travels the long way around the ring (N→C→S or N→E→S). Then discard it and the HSR reopens. (The Globetrotter 阿嬤 is IMMUNE.)

effect: ISLAND-WIDE (not a scoped event — its own banner). The HSR is down for EVERYONE. Until the start of YOUR next turn, North and South are NOT linked — everyone Travels the long way around the ring (N→C→S or N→E→S). Then discard it and the HSR reopens. (The Globetrotter 阿嬤 is IMMUNE.)

name: The Reel Blew Up
effect: ⦿ YOU · A clip you barely edited is everywhere by morning. Grow 2 followers (take 2 from your supply to your board) — a rare big viral.
art_note: A phone screen ticking past a million views overnight

name: Everyone's Filming
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The whole lane is holding up a phone. Every agent standing in Central grows 1 follower (supply to board).
art_note: A night lane where every hand holds a glowing phone

name: Lantern Festival
effect: The island lights up for the Lantern Festival — sky-lanterns and warm crowds, no rites. Every agent grows 1 follower (supply to board).
art_note: Sky-lanterns rising over a night market strung with lights

name: The Comments Turned
effect: The mood online shifts and some of your crowd wanders off. Return 1 of your followers to your OWN supply (they disperse — never to a rival).
art_note: A comment thread cooling from cheers to shrugs

name: The Hype Moves On
effect: The buzz cools and the spotlight drifts to the next new thing. The current LEADER returns 1 follower to their OWN supply (a gentle catch-up — the crowd just moves on, it does not join anyone).
art_note: A once-mobbed stall as the crowd ambles toward a newer one

name: Spring Tea Harvest
effect: First-flush leaves come down the hills. Every agent standing in Central takes 1 free 茶 Tea into their Larder.
art_note: Tea pickers on a misty terraced hillside at first light

name: Rice Comes In
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The valley harvest is in and the farmers are pressing bags of it on anyone who slows down. Every agent standing in East takes 1 free 糧 Pantry rice into their Larder.
art_note: Golden rice terraces being harvested in the eastern valley

name: Oyster Glut
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The oyster rafts came in heavy tonight and the whole harbour's shucking at once. Every agent standing in South takes 1 free 海鮮 Seafood into their Larder.
art_note: Baskets of fresh oysters glistening under harbour lights

name: Heat Wave
effect: The afternoon sun is brutal and stock turns fast. Every agent standing in South lets 1 held ingredient of their choice go off (to the region discard).
art_note: Heat shimmer rising off a sun-baked coastal market

name: The Fridge Broke
effect: The chiller packed in mid-service. 1 held 海鮮 Seafood or 豬肉 Meat of your choice goes off (to the region discard) — perishables only.
art_note: A stall fridge with its door ajar and a warm hum

name: Picked Clean
effect: A tour bus got here first and cleared the good stuff. Put the top card of this region's market to the BOTTOM of its deck.
art_note: An empty market table just after a coach party swept through

name: Poached the Supplier
effect: The frontrunner's regular supplier gets a better offer. Take 1 ingredient of your choice from the current LEADER into your Larder (a cheeky poach — magnitude 1, one Market Run from replacement).
art_note: A supplier being quietly handed a rival agency's card

name: Cut in Line
effect: You slip in ahead while they are deciding. Take 1 ingredient of your choice from ONE agent standing here with you (they can see you and can leave next turn).
art_note: A hand reaching past someone at a crowded stall counter

name: Borrowed the Recipe
effect: You talk your way into the leader's kitchen for one item. Name an ingredient type and take 1 of it from the current LEADER into your Larder.
art_note: A cook copying a scribbled recipe card over a rival's shoulder

name: The Big Typhoon
effect: A serious storm shuts the street. Until the start of each affected player's next turn, no market draws in South — but everyone here is home doom-scrolling food pics, so each agent standing in South also grows 1 follower (supply to board).
art_note: Shutters down and a warm-lit window against driving rain

name: No Signal
effect: Out here the bars drop to nothing. Your NEXT Travel grows no follower (you still move — you just cannot post from the road).
art_note: A phone showing no-signal on a dark mountain road

name: The Boss Wants a Word
effect: Head office calls you in for a chat. You cannot Promote on your next turn (a tempo hiccup, nothing lost).
art_note: An agent taking a call from the head-office desk

name: Roadworks
effect: The road out is dug up until the crews clear it. Until the end-of-round refill, no agent can Travel OUT of this region.
art_note: A friendly hi-vis crew and a dug-up road with cones

name: Landslide on the Pass
effect: The mountain pass is closed for clearing. One ring link to a NEIGHBOURING region is severed until the start of the affected player's next turn (the HSR is unaffected).
art_note: A cleared rockfall on a switchback mountain road at night

name: Pop-Up Stall
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · A pop-up unfolds out of nowhere in minutes flat. Refill 1 EMPTY vendor slot in this region now (a small relief from the slow refill; nothing happens if no slot is empty).
art_note: A cart unfolding into a bright little stall in minutes

name: Sharing Tables
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · The lunch rush packs every stall and total strangers are squeezing onto your table — 併桌! Each agent standing in Central places up to 1 follower from their board onto the co-located face-up vendor here (a free half-Promote; the crowd's already at the table).
art_note: Strangers cheerfully squeezing onto a packed shared table at a busy stall

name: New Management
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · A stall changes hands overnight and the new owner rewrites the board. Discard the face-up vendor here and refill it from this region's deck (a fresh face for the same corner).
art_note: A new owner hanging a fresh sign over an old stall

name: The Queue That Ate the Block
effect: ⬢ THIS REGION · A queue forms from nowhere and doubles back down the block. Drop a Trending marker on the face-up vendor here (the cheapest, if more than one) — whoever WINS it grows 1 follower.
art_note: A daytime queue snaking around the corner of a block

name: Golden Week
effect: The long holiday fills every street. Until the end-of-round refill, every agent's Market Run keeps +1 ingredient (the island is out eating).
art_note: A packed holiday high street under bright banners

name: The 3:47 to Zuoying
effect: You sprint and just make the last bullet train south. Make a free HSR move now (North to South, or South to North).
art_note: An agent dashing through the gates as the HSR doors close

name: Back On the Itinerary
effect: ⦿ YOU · Back on the itinerary — a cancelled tour reopens. Shed ONE of your OWN Cancelled 取消 tours: remove its cancellation penalty (the card goes to the box, not the Completed pile). A rare self-relief; fizzles if you hold no Cancelled tour.
art_note: Boarding-pass card — a 取消 CANCELLED stamp being peeled back off an itinerary as the tour reopens

name: Someone Has to Run It
effect: ✦ THE LOWEST-SCORING RIVAL · Someone has to run it. Take 1 Cancelled 取消 tour from the lowest-scoring rival into YOUR Completed pile at HALF value (round the tour's value down) — and that rival sheds its cancellation penalty. A bounded catch-up double-boon; the standings pick the rival, not you (no kingmaking). Fizzles if no rival holds a Cancelled tour.
art_note: A departing agent handing their route clipboard to another who picks it up — a stall kept running
